text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
A decorated runner who passes on her<n>
ambition to your trainee is called a<n>
Veteran Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Once a runner has completed her<n>Career,
she can be registered as a<n>Veteran
Umamusume and chosen as a<n>Legacy.
color_text_info_list: registered as a Veteran Umamusume and chosen as a Legacy

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, go ahead and choose your<n>
Legacies.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Legacies can pass on Sparks of<n>
Inspiration, which grant your trainee<n>
attribute boosts and skill hints, among<n>
other benefits.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And don't worry, Legacies can inspire<n>new
trainees as many times as you like!
